newsitem.title: USA: Eldorado, Commerce Security merger approved.
newsitem.headline: Eldorado, Commerce Security merger approved.

text.p: Eldorado Bancorp said its shareholders approved terms of its previously-announced merger deal with Commerce Security Bancorp Inc, and the agreement also had regulatory approval.
Under the terms of the agreement, Commerce Security would acquire Eldorado Bancorp for $23 in cash for each Eldorado common share, the company said.
The deal was expected to close on June 6, it said.
Eldorado said its shareholders approved terms at an April 30 meeting, and the California State Banking Department as well as the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco gave their approvals in May.
Eldorado, through its Eldorado bank unit, operates 12 branch banking offices in Orange, Los Angeles, Riverside and San Bernardino counties in California.
